2607.27379.title: HSS-Synth: Humanities and Social Sciences Data Synthesis for LLMs
2607.27379.paper_summary: High-quality, diverse data are vital for large language models (LLMs) but remain scarce and costly. Data synthesis is a viable alternative and succeeds on closed tasks, yet the humanities and social sciences (HSS) are overlooked, and their open-ended nature makes synthesis challenging. Moving beyond prior capability-centric, fragmented attempts, we adopt a subject-centric paradigm, define the first HSS domain system covering 14 mainstream fields, and introduce HSS-Synth, the first data synthesis pipeline for HSS. HSS-Synth comprises: (1) constructing seed documents from web corpora via multi-step filtering and text refinement evaluated by a judge; (2) specifying "requirements + persona" to backtranslate seed documents into diverse yet faithful instructions with a strict Q&A alignment check; and (3) breaking LLM response limits via teacher-forced Answering that feeds seed documents during response generation to anchor semantics, reduce hallucinations, and preserve tone and integrity. HSS-Synth yields 237k high-quality, diverse instruction-tuning samples that outperform 14 leading baselines on 16 benchmarks. The fine-tuned Qwen3-8B-Base sets a new SOTA and approaches the official Qwen3-8B, improving both human preference and knowledge capabilities without performance seesaws. Extensive experiments demonstrate HSS-Synth's robustness and transferability. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/pengr/HSS-Synth.
2607.27379.paper_summary_zh: 高品質、多樣化的數據對於大型語言模型（LLMs）至關重要，但仍然稀缺且成本高昂。數據合成是一種可行的替代方案，並且在封閉任務上取得成功，但人文學科和社會科學（HSS）卻被忽視，其開放式特性使得合成變得具有挑戰性。超越以往以能力為中心的零散嘗試，我們採用以主題為中心的範式，定義了第一個涵蓋14個主流領域的HSS領域系統，並介紹HSS-Synth，第一個針對HSS的數據合成管道。HSS-Synth包括：（1）通過多步過濾和由評審評估的文本精煉從網絡語料庫構建種子文檔；（2）指定“需求 + 人物”以將種子文檔反向翻譯為多樣化但忠實的指令，並進行嚴格的問答對齊檢查；以及（3）通過教師強制回答來打破LLM的響應限制，在響應生成過程中提供種子文檔，以固定語義、減少幻覺並保持語調和完整性。HSS-Synth產生了237k高品質、多樣化的指令調整樣本，在16個基準上超越了14個領先基準。經過微調的Qwen3-8B-Base創造了新的SOTA，並接近官方的Qwen3-8B，在不造成性能波動的情況下提高了人類偏好和知識能力。大量實驗證明了HSS-Synth的穩健性和可轉移性。我們的代碼已公開在 https://github.com/pengr/HSS-Synth。
